basics.summary: I'm a student studying for a B.S in Information and Computer Sciences at the University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa, focusing on web application development and software engineering best practices. I expect to graduate in Spring 2027.

education.institution: University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa, Honolulu, HI

work.summary: Supported Guest Room Attendants and Housekeeping leadership to keep guest rooms, lanais, corridors, and service areas clean, stocked, and ready for guests, while providing friendly, responsive service.
highlights: Assisted Guest Room Attendants with daily room preparation and reset to maintain clean and welcoming spaces.
Maintained corridors and service areas, replenishing linens and amenities to support smooth housekeeping operations.
Coordinated with housekeeping leadership during high-occupancy periods to prioritize tasks and meet time-sensitive demands.
Responded to guest requests using Four Seasons service standards to help ensure a positive and memorable stay.

volunteer.summary: Dedicated to restoring, protecting, and enhancing the natural resources of Hawaiʻi.
highlights: Participate in meetings and discussions focused on sustainable soil and water management in West Hawaiʻi.
Support conservation and outreach efforts that connect local communities to responsible land and resource use.
